IC1.IC1.1: The patient was on nonsteroid anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) treatment on the day when consent was obtained,
IC1.IC1.2: and requires the long-term continuous treatment even after treatment with the investigational drug is started.

IC2.IC2.1: The patient was confirmed to have a history of gastric ulcer or duodenal ulcer.

EC1.EC1.1: Endoscopically confirmed gastric and/or duodenal ulcers on Day 1.

EC2.EC2.1: Endoscopically confirmed active upper gastrointestinal hemorrhage on Day 1.

EC3.EC3.1: Current or past history of aspirin-induced asthma or hypersensitivity to NSAIDs.

EC4.EC4.1: Past or planned surgery affecting gastric acid secretion.

EC5.EC5.1: Clinically significant hepatic or renal disorder.

EC6.EC6.1: Serious cardiac dysfunction, hypertension, or hematological disorder.
